subject: Mid-summer intern ratification + comp-band exception for two conversions
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-cycle intern conversions + two comp-band exceptions (request)

Marcus—

Quick note on the summer slate: recruiting is requesting sign-off to convert six interns to full-time (new-grad) offers and one summer-to-conversion bridge for a returning intern. The hiring managers have recommended bands for each candidate; two of the offers require comp-band exceptions (manager asks to exceed band midpoint based on critical skill set: LLM-systems & CUDA).

Summary (high level):
- 6 conversions / 1 bridge across Infra, Serving Runtime, Developer DX
- Recommended bands attached in candidate_list.csv (row-level notes included)
- Two exceptions: Candidate AZ (Stanford) and Candidate MS (returner) request +10% over band midpoint for equity/market reasons
- Total HC impact: converting 6 interns uses 6 headcount slots planned for Q4; bridge uses existing intern headcount but requires comp approval

Ask: please confirm (1) approval to extend offers at recommended bands; (2) green light to grant the two comp exceptions or route to VP People if you prefer escalation. If approved, Offer Ops will generate P0 templates and we’ll aim to send offers by 7/18.

Attachments: candidate_list.csv (recommended bands, manager notes)

Thanks—
Laura Bennett
Director, University Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle intern conversions + two comp-band exceptions (request)

Laura—

Thanks for the summarized list. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I sign off:
1) For the two exceptions, can you call out why midpoint +10% is the right lever vs. larger equity grant? I want to understand comp mix impacts.
2) Headcount: you said converting 6 uses Q4 slots — can we absorb these under existing campus hiring forecast, or do we need to pull additional HC from infra backlog?
3) Any external offer contingencies (visa, background) that could delay acceptance past 7/18?

If answers are short I can rubber-stamp today; otherwise I’ll hold until EOD 7/6.

—Marcus
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2027 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle intern conversions + two comp-band exceptions (request)

Marcus—

Answers below and forwarding the candidate note from Alice at Stanford so you can see timing expectations.

1) Exceptions rationale: both candidates are on rare infra/ML-systems tracks where the external market has shortened supply. Managers prefer modest cash uplift (+10% midpoint) to avoid creating future equity band pressure; offer templates include a slightly higher signing equity but within band ceiling. We modeled two scenarios (sheet tab): midpoint+10% cash + standard equity, or midpoint +0% cash + elevated equity. Managers prefer cash for relocation simplicity.

2) HC: conversions replace the intern slots planned in Q4 for new grads; we do not need additional HC authorizations. The bridge (returner) will reuse an existing internship HC but requires comp sign-off because manager requests higher base than intern-to-newgrad default.

3) Contingencies: two candidates are international; recruiting has initiated visa checks and expects no delays beyond typical timeline. Background checks are standard; Offer Ops noted no red flags so far.

Attached: offer_template_RDW_intern.pdf (editable), candidate_list.csv (detailed rows).

Forwarded message:
> From: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@stanford.edu>
> Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 14:03:00 -0700
> To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
> Subject: Re: Summer internship follow-up
>
> Hi Laura — thanks for the update. If an offer comes through by mid-July, I can confirm acceptance within 48 hours. I have one other on-campus final loop the week of 7/19 but expect Redwood to be my top choice.
>
> Best,
> Alice

Let me know if you want the scenario modeling for compensation broken out by equity vs cash; otherwise I recommend approving midpoint+10% for the two exceptions to keep managers competitive.

—Laura

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle intern conversions + two comp-band exceptions (request)

Marcus/Laura—

Read both notes. Approved: convert the six interns and approve the bridge. For the two comp exceptions I authorize midpoint+10% in base as a one-time approver-level exception; Offer Ops may proceed to generate offers under that parameter. Please ensure Offer Ops copies VP People if they follow a different approval matrix for international candidates.

A couple items:
- Confirm total FY run-rate delta to Finance after offers are issued (send to finance-ops).
- If any candidate requests more than the approved +10%, escalate to VP People for sign-off.

Thanks — proceed to send offers by 7/18 and flag me only if there’s pushback.

—Vivek
Director, Eng Ops
Redwood Inference
